# dsh-disk-manager
English | 中文
Browse local disks from the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar, following the logic of Windows Disk Mana
gement / File Explorer: volume overview, folder browsing, folder size accounting, desktop shortcuts,
and hover previews.
> Windows only. Browsing plus exactly two write operations: delete (always to the Recycle Bin) and c
reate folder. **No partition operations** (extend / shrink / format are not implemented).
## Features
- **Volume overview** — every drive laid out like "This PC": drive glyph, `Label (X:)`, used-space b

ar, `X free of Y`
- **Folder browsing** — enter any directory; sort by name / size / modified time /

type; group; detailed or compact density
- **Address bar** — click to turn it into an input, type a

path, press Enter
- **Folder size on demand** — right-click a folder to measure it; deadline-guarde

d so the UI never hangs
- **Open by type** — text, code, images, PDF, Office go to the built-in side

bar preview; video, audio, and archives go to the system default program
- **Desktop dock** — deskto

p contents are laid out inline under the volume list; shortcuts show the real application icon
- **H
over peek** — rest the pointer on a folder and a floating panel shows its contents, up to three leve

ls, with drill-down
- **Multiple panes** — "Open in new tab" gives each panel its own drive and its

own remembered location
- **Delete** — right-click a file or folder, confirm once, it goes to the Re

cycle Bin
- **New folder** — right-click empty space inside a directory, type a name, it is created
in place; an existing name is reported instead of overwritten

> The plugin has two halves: `index.js` runs in the DSH host process, `client.js` runs in the browse
r. **Changing `index.js` requires a DSH restart**; a page refresh only reloads `client.js`.

## Usage
**Install, then restart DSH once.** The host half registers an HTTP route (`/api/dsh-disk`) that onl
y comes alive after a restart — before that, every action reports "backend not ready". The client ha
lf hot-reloads, the host half does not.
### Where the new buttons are
After restarting, look at the **session header** — the row of small icons above the input box. Two n
ew buttons appear there:
| Icon | Tooltip | What it opens |
| Monitor | Desktop files | Your Desktop folder as a right-sidebar tab, with a tree you can expand i

n place |
| Stacked folder | Workspace files | Documents each conversation in this workspace produce
d, grouped by conversation |
Both open as tabs in the right sidebar, so you can keep several of them open at once.
### Disk panel

1. Click the monitor icon (or any volume in an already-open disk tab) to reach the volume list
2. Cl

ick a volume to enter it, or type a path into the address bar and press Enter
3. Click a folder to e

xpand it in place; double-click to open it as its own page
4. Right-click a file or folder: open in
the built-in preview, open with the system app, reveal in Explorer, copy path, delete (Recycle Bin o

nly)
5. Right-click a volume card: open, open in new tab, disk checkup, properties
### Workspace files panel

1. Click the stacked-folder icon
2. The list is grouped by conversation, newest first; click a group

header to collapse or expand
3. Click a document to open it in DSH's built-in preview; right-click

for system app / reveal / copy path / delete
4. The search box filters across all groups by file nam

or system app / reveal / copy path / delete
4. The search box filters across all groups by file name
## Compatibility
| Item | Requirement |

| OS | Windows 10 / 11 |
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.5` (tested version) |
| PowerShell | Windows PowerShell

5.1 (bundled with Windows) |
| Dependencies | None |
## Known limitations

- **Windows only** — the host half depends entirely on Windows APIs and PowerShell
- **No partition

operations** — extend, shrink, and format are not offered
- **No permanent delete** — deletion alway

s goes through the Recycle Bin
- **No rename or undo** — hence no "undo rename" in the context menu

either
- **No auto refresh** — changes on disk need a manual refresh
- **Icons** — resolved through
`SHGetFileInfo`, which covers UWP and classic apps; a rare misregistered AppX package may fall back

to a generic icon
- **PowerShell disabled** — icons degrade to file-type icons; everything else keep

ric icon
- **PowerShell disabled** — icons degrade to file-type icons; everything else keeps working
## Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Host endpoints: `volumes` `ls` `size` `open` `reveal` `terminal` `mkdir` `info` `cleanup` `clipboard
` `icons` `trash` `settings`.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`npm test` builds a sandbox in the system temp directory and runs 7 checks — volume enumeration, dir
ectory listing, folder size, create folder, duplicate-name message, file properties, empty-path reje
ction — then cleans up.
`npm run test:market` reads `index.json` and validates it with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-i
ndex` copy shipped with DSH: field rules, relative icon resolution, and the generated install spec.
Failures report the JSON path of the offending value.
